title: President of Manglefeet's Fan Club

html:
President of Manglefeet's Fan Club

The President of Manglefeet's Fan Club is a large purple version of Rotgut! Like Rottie, he attacks with his machine gun, but he has a really devastating rolling attack which can knock back and one shot the strongest characters. He is also protected by Roadies and Groupies but they are really not very tough for high level characters.
